item.title: Patch: Critical Node-RED Flaw Exploited in Attacks
item.description:
Siemens SIMATIC (several versions): RCE · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited (news only) · fix: V4.3.4-1

First step: Update the affected Siemens products to V4.3.4-1 or later.

A vulnerability has been identified in SIMATIC IoT2050 Advanced (6ES7647-0BA00-1YA2) (All versions < V4.3.4-1 running Industrial OS with Node-RED installed), SIMATIC IoT2050 Advanced (6ES7647-0BA00-1YA2) (All versions running Example Image versions with Node-RED installed), SIMATIC IoT2050 Basic (6ES7647-0BA00-0YA2) (All versions < V4.3.4-1 running Industrial OS with Node-RED installed), SIMATIC IoT2050 Basic…

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-58115
